declared_before: Any new follow-up training or validation generation; explicitly informed by the original v4 validation, not declared before all v4 outputs
scope: Validation-informed, fresh lower-learning-rate replication under the unchanged gold, generation settings, completion and nonregression gates; final test remains unopened

manual_grading.sources: Frozen validation rows, corresponding source photos and predeclared per-question rubrics
manual_grading.grader: Fresh independent subagent, actual source inspection for photo/region judgments
manual_grading.pass: Correct requested fact or complete relevant response; equivalent wording accepted. Unsupported scene/action/intent, invented facts, reversed relations or ignoring requested language/context fail.
manual_grading.completion: Confirm each raw generation: stop_reason=eos, ended_with_eos=true, final raw token in declared EOS IDs, and neither truncated nor unknown. variant.completed only confirms count, not completion. An EOS at the exact token cap remains complete even when reached_max_new_tokens is true. Any actual truncation or unknown completion is incorrect and makes an adapter ineligible.
manual_grading.text_chat_override: Chat rows carry predeclared_semantic_rubric. Ignore the runtime default exact-match pass_rate for these nine answers; use independently recorded semantic grades under the frozen rubric.

exact_grading.text_presence: Frozen exact yes/no target after the declared row normalization; no substring matching
exact_grading.single_ocr: Frozen whole target using common normalization, then remove all whitespace as declared on each OCR row. Preserve script and punctuation.
exact_grading.ordered_ocr: Frozen multiline target using common normalization, preserve all internal whitespace and line breaks. Exact ordered transcription, not a pure reading-order score.
exact_grading.common_normalization: NFKC then outer strip, exactly matching runtime normalize. Do not convert Simplified/Traditional, punctuation or case.

score.primary: Arithmetic mean of five capability scores, each with weight 0.2
score.photo: Mean of summary accuracy and narrow-fact accuracy
score.dialogue: Mean of text-chat, typed-reference voice-question chat and actual-ASR voice-question chat accuracy
score.asr: Report raw and declared normalized micro CER separately; ASR is fixed before this selection
score.exact_comparison: Use fractions, or weighted integer numerator / 75600: summary*270 + fact*135 + presence*840 + single_ocr*1512 + ordered_ocr*5040 + text_chat*560 + typed_voice_chat*1260 + actual_asr_chat*1260. Compare integers for improvement and ties, not rounded floats.

selection: Choose an eligible adapter only when its unrounded primary score is strictly above base. Choose the highest eligible score; ties between adapters choose the earlier archive. Ties with base choose base. If neither is eligible, select base and report that the fine-tuning did not meet the predeclared improvement standard.
test_guard: Commit the chosen validation decision and exact adapter/base hashes before one new heldout test. Do not change gold, normalization, model settings or selected weights in response to final test results.
uncertainty: Small validation denominators and related questions are not independent trials. One-question changes can move a score substantially; show counts and avoid population/generalization claims.
data_freeze: Final manifest SHA and current source hashes will be recorded in the experiment plan before any train or LM validation stage.

prior_validation.reason: Original adapters improved photo summary/facts but regressed on paired voice-question chat, and neither met all-EOS. Lower LR is the sole recipe change; it is a hypothesis rather than a promised repair.
